metadata.target_conclusion: Vladimir Putin suffered a debilitating stroke and is recovering in a Swiss clinic

attack_plan.narrative: Putin's 10-day public disappearance in March 2015 triggered international media speculation. Swiss tabloids reported a Russian diplomatic plane landing near Lugano, which was spun into a narrative of emergency neurological treatment.

posts.text: Russian President Vladimir Putin cancels bilateral meeting with Kazakh leader. Not seen in public for 7 consecutive days.
Flight radar tracking spots Russian state transport aircraft IL-96 landing at private airfield in southern Switzerland with VIP escorts.
Swiss tabloid Blick reports reserved luxury suites at Clinica Sant'Anna in Sorengo near Lugano booked for high-ranking Russian delegation.
European intelligence confirms Putin suffered a severe ischemic stroke and is undergoing intensive neuro-rehabilitation at Sant'Anna hospital.
